action.new_text:
def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be numpy arrays")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be 2D matrices")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must have the same shape")
    if not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_with_result)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_call_only)) or not np.all(np.isfinite(logp_no_call)):
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be finite")
    if not np.all(logp_with_result <= 0) or not np.all(logp_call_only <= 0) or not np.all(logp_no_call <= 0):
        raise ValueError("All log probability inputs must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Step 1: Compute normalized decreasing future-token weights
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * np.arange(future_horizon))
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Step 2: Compute weighted negative log probability losses
    L_plus = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(normalized_weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Step 3: Stronger counterfactual baseline
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Step 4: Compute margin and apply threshold
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
